blocked_dates_time_check.name: blocked_dates_time_check
blocked_dates_time_check.value: ("blocked_dates"."start_time" IS NULL AND "blocked_dates"."end_time" IS NULL) OR ("blocked_dates"."start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "blocked_dates"."end_time" IS NOT NULL AND "blocked_dates"."start_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "blocked_dates"."end_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "blocked_dates"."start_time" < "blocked_dates"."end_time")

calculator_item_pricing_check.name: calculator_item_pricing_check
calculator_item_pricing_check.value: "calculator_items"."pricing_type" IN ('flat', 'per_unit') AND ("calculator_items"."pricing_type" <> 'per_unit' OR ("calculator_items"."max_units" IS NOT NULL AND "calculator_items"."max_units" > 0))

pages_publish_check.name: pages_publish_check
pages_publish_check.value: ("pages"."status" = 'draft' AND "pages"."published_at" IS NULL) OR ("pages"."status" = 'published' AND "pages"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

projects_publish_image_check.name: projects_publish_image_check
projects_publish_image_check.value: "projects"."status" = 'draft' OR ("projects"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."featured_image_id" IS NOT NULL)

inquiry_source_check.name: inquiry_source_check
inquiry_source_check.value: ("inquiries"."source" = 'package' AND "inquiries"."service_package_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."quote_request_id" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."package_name" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."package_price" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."package_billing_type" IS NOT NULL) OR ("inquiries"."source" = 'contact' AND "inquiries"."service_package_id" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."quote_request_id" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."package_name" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."package_price" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."package_billing_type" IS NULL) OR ("inquiries"."source" = 'calculator' AND "inquiries"."quote_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."service_package_id" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."package_name" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."package_price" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."package_billing_type" IS NULL)

package_discount_check.name: package_discount_check
package_discount_check.value: ("service_packages"."discount_price" IS NULL AND "service_packages"."discount_ends_at" IS NULL) OR ("service_packages"."discount_price" IS NOT NULL AND "service_packages"."discount_ends_at" IS NOT NULL)

package_numeric_check.name: package_numeric_check
package_numeric_check.value: "service_packages"."estimated_days" >= 0 AND "service_packages"."included_revisions" >= 0 AND ("service_packages"."extra_revision_price" IS NULL OR "service_packages"."extra_revision_price" >= 0) AND "service_packages"."sort_order" >= 0

project_documents_type_check.name: project_documents_type_check
project_documents_type_check.value: "project_documents"."type" IN ('url', 'file') AND (("project_documents"."type" = 'url' AND "project_documents"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "project_documents"."file_id" IS NULL) OR ("project_documents"."type" = 'file' AND "project_documents"."file_id" IS NOT NULL AND "project_documents"."url" IS NULL))
